# The enums inside the app's kept files, by file and version: `file@version
# enum names`, or `lenient` for one that reads a name it doesn't have. A
# new variant an older build can't read is a new version of the file: bump
# it, keep the old version's reader, and append the new version's lines.
# From the public beta, a line here is never changed or removed.
